name: Homeless
source: The main character is a former soccer player who was forced to retire early and started using his knowledge to stay in the business, as a businessman and a talent scout. In a wedding on the verge of ruin with a famous and disagreeable actress, he is forced to shelter a homeless person in his house for a few days. And to make matters worse, she still brings a younger brother. How he will handle this whole situation is up to you.
translation: 男主角曾是一名职业足球运动员，被迫早早退役后，开始凭借自己的专业眼光转型为商人与球探，继续留在足坛打拼。正值他与一位名气响亮却性格难缠的女演员的婚礼濒临破裂之际，他不得不收留一名无家可归的女子在自己家中暂住几天。更糟的是，她居然还拖着一个弟弟同行。他将如何应付这团乱麻般的局面，全由你来决定。
